items.docs: Creates a new role in the Control Room with the specified name, description, and set of permissions. Roles are used to grant users access to specific features, folders, and API operations.
Retrieves a paginated, filterable list of Control Room roles. Supports filtering by name and other attributes. Returns role metadata including permissions and member counts.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the role

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a specific role, including its name, description, permissions, and the list of users assigned to it.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the role

items.docs: Updates an existing role's name, description, and permission set. Changes apply immediately to all users assigned to the role.

items.docs: Permanently deletes a Control Room role. Users assigned only to this role will lose associated permissions. System roles (AAE_Admin, AAE_Basic) cannot be deleted.
